purpose: Bounded Agent codec diagnosis for owner-film scanner 1.0.7 repair
probe_scope: Pure in-memory FieldSpec/audio-curve/timeline-validator probes; no owner data

seams.name: FieldSpec.to_stored
seams.role: Strict authoring coercion; dispatches by declared kind and audio flag
seams.bad_stored_form_behavior: Rejects the targeted bad values when called on them, but accepts human numeric strings such as "0.5"; therefore it is not by itself a stored-JSON shape validator
seams.scanner_use: Call only as a field-level semantic probe after the declared storage-shape check; never write its returned value back

seams.name: FieldSpec.from_stored
seams.bad_stored_form_behavior: Normalizes/accepts non-mapping animation strings, lists and booleans; numeric bools can become defaults or formatted numbers; numeric bounds are not checked
seams.scanner_use: Presentation only, never the acceptance predicate

seams.name: clip_fields.describe
seams.role: Whole-clip human description over all declared fields
seams.bad_stored_form_behavior: Raises for some malformed numeric/duration strings/lists but silently describes malformed animation scalar/list/bool values and does not validate audio curve IDs
seams.scanner_use: Keep for existing display output only; do not infer complete/known from success

seams.name: clip_fields.read
seams.bad_stored_form_behavior: Returns raw value without codec validation

seams.name: audio_curves.validate
seams.role: Strict registry membership check for audio curve IDs
seams.bad_stored_form_behavior: Rejects unknown strings and non-hashable values; accepts only registry names
seams.scanner_use: Probe params.fadeInCurve/params.fadeOutCurve separately; missing/null/linear retain absent/default semantics

seams.name: timeline_check_curve_validation
seams.bad_stored_form_behavior: Only checks curve IDs; does not validate fadeIn/fadeOut duration values
seams.scanner_use: Do not invoke whole Check from scanner; reuse the underlying audio_curves seam

seams.name: timeline_config_schema_and_validate_timeline
seams.bad_stored_form_behavior: Catches top-level known-field type/shape errors, but accepts opacity/crop out-of-range and speed <= 0; params is open so audio fades/curves are not checked; transition catalog semantics reject vendor IDs
seams.scanner_use: Do not add as a second scanner validator; preserve scanner's open transition policy and one-projector closure

fade_in_alias.note: Use entrance spec for shared entrance storage so non-fade animations remain valid; fade_in is a visual presentation alias

fade_out_alias.note: Use exit spec for shared exit storage so non-fade animations remain valid; fade_out is a visual presentation alias

volume.note: Declared and both-applicable, but not in scanner 1.0.7 _LOOK_NAMES; do not silently expand scanner scope without a decision

fade_in_curve.note: Not a FieldSpec; path is hard-coded in clip_fields.write and timeline_cuts

fade_out_curve.note: Not a FieldSpec; path is hard-coded in clip_fields.write and timeline_cuts

adversarial_cases.from_stored_describe: BAD/list raise; true is treated as default and omitted; 1.5 formats as 1.5
adversarial_cases.repair_effect: must fail closed; do not trust describe omission

adversarial_cases.from_stored_describe: scalar/list/bool and unknown type are formatted/accepted; bad duration raises; zero duration formats as 0s
adversarial_cases.schema: Draft-07 fragment rejects scalar/list/bad duration/zero; type ID remains open
adversarial_cases.repair_effect: use entrance/exit spec, not fade alias, then preserve unknown extension params

adversarial_cases.from_stored_describe: BAD/list raise; true formats as 1; bounds are not checked
adversarial_cases.repair_effect: field-level failure must retain affected unknown finding

adversarial_cases.from_stored_describe: BAD/list raise; true equals default and is omitted; 0/-1 format
adversarial_cases.schema: Draft-07 fragment rejects only type if applicable; semantic to_stored catches <=0
adversarial_cases.repair_effect: do not use describe success as validity

adversarial_cases.from_stored_describe: BAD/list raise; true formats as 30f; 0/-1 format
adversarial_cases.schema: Draft-07 fragment accepts positive number/null only

adversarial_cases.describe: does not call validate; appends any truthy raw curve to human text
adversarial_cases.repair_effect: validate curve separately; preserve existing unknown-string curve knowledge policy and treat shape-invalid values as unreadable

adversarial_cases.to_stored: None returns a deletion value; cf.write(..., None) removes the path
adversarial_cases.repair_effect: missing/null are absent declarations, not errors; never turn clear into unknown
do not inspect/strip/rewrite unknown extension data

adversarial_cases.scanner_policy: retain existing free-form string/mapping inventory policy; do not route through transition coerce/catalog validation

exact_mapping: Enumerate every present declared FieldSpec path; include spec.stored_at_audio for audio fades.
For visual entrance/exit storage, probe FIELDS['entrance'] or FIELDS['exit']; do not probe the fade aliases as if all animations were fades.
For params.fadeIn/params.fadeOut, call the matching fade FieldSpec.to_stored(raw, audio=True).
For params.fadeInCurve/params.fadeOutCurve, call audio_curves.validate(raw) separately; no FieldSpec exists for curves.

Use the existing FieldSpec.schema as a Draft-07 per-field storage-shape check if needed (its type arrays are Draft-07 fragments); then use FieldSpec.to_stored for semantic bounds/animation/duration checks. Do not call generic jsonschema.validate on the fragment under its default newer draft.
Keep cf.describe only for presentation after the field probe. Never use a successful describe, an omitted key, or a normalized human string as proof that stored data was valid.
On field failure, emit only the bounded authored source path, mark the affected finding unknown, and make the scan incomplete. Do not copy raw malformed values or exception text.

Do not call validate_timeline from scanner or add a parallel whole-document validator. Keep one project_runtime_parent_composition call, explicit clears, open params/extension data, and the settled free-form transition policy.
repair_recommendation.scope_warning: volume is declared in clip_fields.yaml but scanner 1.0.7 does not inventory it; preserve that scope unless separately decided

observed_limits: FieldSpec.to_stored is an authoring codec and accepts numeric strings; a stored-shape check is needed if strings must fail closed.
FieldSpec.from_stored and clip_fields.describe are not validators.
FieldSpec.schema fragments use Draft-07 type-array syntax and are not directly valid under the default jsonschema draft in this environment.
No owner data, full suite, network, browser, renderer, listener, install, or shared dependency mutation was performed.
